description: Single source of the log/trace PII scrubbing patterns (P03 deliverable 5, R-DP / C2-10). Applied in order. RE2-compatible (OpenTelemetry Collector OTTL) and Python-re-compatible (backend logging filter, scripts/ci/pii_scrub.py). Patterns are generic shapes, not official formats; test data is synthetic.
attribute_keys_note: Only free-text attributes are scrubbed; identifiers (trace_id, tenant_id, company_id, UUIDs) are kept intact.
